tools.name: list_areas
tools.description: List all Dubai areas (neighborhoods) available in the dataset. Use to discover valid area names.

tools.name: area_snapshot
tools.description: Price snapshot for residential property in a Dubai area from official DLD sale transactions: sample size, median sale price (AED), median price per m2, date range.

tools.name: rental_yield
tools.description: Gross rental yield for residential property in a Dubai area: median annual rent per m2, median sale price per m2, and gross yield %, from official DLD sale + rental (Ejari) data.

tools.name: market_overview
tools.description: Overall Dubai real estate snapshot: total transactions, areas, date range, median sale price (AED), top 5 areas by volume.

tools.name: rank_areas_by_yield
tools.description: Rank Dubai areas by gross rental yield (highest first), from official DLD sale + rental data. Great for finding the best-yielding neighbourhoods.

tools.name: compare_areas
tools.description: Compare 2-5 Dubai areas side by side: median sale price, price per m2, and gross rental yield.

tools.name: affordability
tools.description: Given a budget in AED, list Dubai areas where the median sale price fits (largest you can afford first).
